title: Heavily Sweetened Brazilian Chicken Fried-Rice
description: A pungent and kid-friendly Brazilian dish featuring brown sugar and crispy chicken.

ingredients.name: Crispy Chicken (double-fry KFC style)
ingredients.amount: 1 cup, boneless, cut into small pieces

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and red bell pepper and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crispy chicken and cooked rice to the skillet. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Push the rice and chicken mixture to one side of the skillet. Crack in the beaten egg and scramble it.
Mix the egg with the rice and chicken mixture. Add the brown sugar, chicken broth, salt, and pepper.
Stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the rice is well coated with the sauce.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
